items.briefing:
A new study highlights that AI-related security incidents are costing large organisations millions of dollars, a reminder that AI tools introduce real business risks if not properly managed. Separately, research shows some AI models can resist safety corrections, meaning AI systems your organisation uses may behave unexpectedly despite vendor assurances — worth raising with your IT or procurement team when evaluating AI products.

On the broader threat landscape, data breaches continue to be reported globally this week. If you reuse passwords across work and personal accounts, a breach elsewhere can expose your workplace systems too.

**Tip:** Use a unique password for every work account and enable multi-factor authentication wherever possible.

featured.title: Weekly Update 514: This Week in Data Breaches
featured.quote: Origin Energy breach affects millions of Australians, highlighting critical infrastructure vulnerability.
